scope: All committed candidate changes, including new files; applicable PDF, public wire, owner, continuation and lifecycle requirements.
excluded: Uncommitted delivery documentation and evidence as code findings
Known unfinished acceptance evidence as code defects

closedFindings.originalFinding: Dense PDF search matches and escaped long text could exceed the Gateway tool-result text limit and block native pairing.
closedFindings.requirement: #214 section 4: retain full results while bounding model projections and providing continued access.

evidence.reason: Validates the actual serialized feedback against modelToolResultSchema.shape.text.
Search projection shrinks match count until within the wire limit; full result remains retained.
Page feedback dynamically shrinks the text projection until the encoded payload fits.
find_pdf now returns the bounded pdfSearchOutcome.

regressionEvidence.provenance: Existing main-agent pdf-review-green.log observed: dense find and adjacent long-page continuation both passed; no reviewer rerun.

closedFindings.originalFinding: A long adjacent page was always truncated at its prefix without a model-accessible continuation entry.
closedFindings.requirement: #214 sections 4 and 9: continue reading retained material without replacing the fixed input or converting it again.

evidence.reason: Truncated projections identify read_pdf_text and the retained readingId.
Pure retained native-text range read returns start, end, total and nextStart with bounded encoded feedback.
The model receives the read_pdf_text schema with referenceId, readingId, page, start and length.
Prepare verifies the selected reference and matches the retained reading documentId and SHA256.
Dispatch rechecks document identity and SHA256 before returning retained text; it does not render.

regressionEvidence.provenance: Unauthorized continuation negative case is committed and was reported green by the main agent; adjacent-page tail positives were also observed green.

closedFindings.originalFinding: The school client rejected the implemented public PDF /find endpoint before reaching local forwarding or result parsing.
closedFindings.requirement: #214 owner and deployment boundaries: the same public capability contract across local and school connections.

evidence.reason: The local binding forwards /find to learning.pdf.find.
The remote response is parsed using pdfSearchResultSchema.

regressionEvidence.provenance: Existing main-agent course regression output observed green; the public school-forwarding regression and final PDF 32/32 were reported passed by the main agent.

closedFindings.originalFinding: Exact MIME comparison rejected valid case variants or parameterized PDF types already recognized by the UI.
closedFindings.requirement: #218: read course PDF from an authorized published material.

evidence.reason: Course import normalizes case, parameters and whitespace before identifying application/pdf.
The front end uses the same normalization for course PDF opening.

regressionEvidence.provenance: Existing main-agent pdf-review-green.log course case observed passed; final PDF 32/32 reported passed.

conclusion: No remaining confirmed missing implementation, implementation error or scope creep in the reviewed Spec diff. The four original P2 findings are closed.
deliveryBoundary: Spec closure is separate from browser, cross-machine, engineering and teaching-effect evidence.
